title: Private Los Angeles Luxury SUV Tour: Icons, Beaches & Sunset
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Los Angeles in comfort on a private luxury sightseeing tour in a 2024 Cadillac Escalade with a professional chauffeur. This is premium private transportation (not a narrated guided tour). Relax while we handle navigation, parking, and traffic, with flexible photo stops along the way.

Choose 7 or 9 hours and tailor the day to your interests. After booking, tell us your goals (iconic landmarks, beaches, celebrity neighborhoods, shopping, viewpoints) and we’ll suggest an efficient route and stop plan. Follow the recommended itinerary or adjust it anytime.

Popular stops may include Hollywood Sign viewpoints, Hollywood Walk of Fame, Sunset Strip, Beverly Hills & Rodeo Drive, Santa Monica Pier, Venice Beach, and Griffith Observatory (sunset when possible). The extended option can include Malibu for a scenic coastal drive.

Stops may vary based on traffic and the time you choose at each location; we’ll adjust the route in real time within your selected duration.
